note: The Immigration and Nationality Act's United States, in its geographical sense, includes Puerto Rico, so a visitor's entry there is the United States' list (the us list).

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38), definition of the United States (U.S. Code, 2023 edition, govinfo)
sources.said: (38) The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
